profile.name: Claudio
profile.overview: Claudio, the flamboyant Italian exorcist, is a simple, straightforward and no-nonsense character who relies on controlling space in order to lock his opponents down, allowing him to setup mixups or pressure. He possesses a limited but effective set of tools to implement this gameplan, allowing the player to quickly achieve character fluency with him and focus on developing their fundamentals and match-up knowledge. In Heat, his mixups become deadlier, with a low Heat Smash and a safe mid launcher.
profile.playstyle: Simple and solid space control. Use homing, safe mids (b+1, b+3, f+3) to lock the opponent down, whiff punish them for moving, and cash in Starburst (STB) for bigger damage and wall splats. His lows are risky or slow, so most of your damage comes from punishing and keep-out.
strengths: Coverage: b+1 does triple duty as keepout, homing move, and wall splat all in one while being safe
Reliable Punishment: Whiff punishment is incredibly strong thanks to his Heat Engagers and launching options
Locked On: Easy approach with WR2 and f,F+4, the former of which can chip opponents unwilling to duck it
Emergency Buttons: Has access to some of the strongest panic tools in the game under pressure, with db+1+2 and his famous hopkick
Like the Candy: Once attained, Starburst enhances many of his attacks, either making those select moves wall splat or launch, and increases his combo damage via 2,1,2 aerial tailspin
Blue-hot: During Heat, Starburst is always active and he gains a one-time use power low in Heat Smash
weaknesses: Ankle Biter: Lows are either risky (db+4,3, db+3) or slow (SS4), and Heat Smash can still be launched by a few characters
Weak Throw Game: None of his throws break any hazards
Overreliant On Blue Stuff: Below-average combo damage without Starburst or walls
Subpar jabs: Pays for his excellent range with a poor i10 punish and lack of jab extensions

stances.name: Starburst
stances.entry: Gained on counter-hit df+2, ws2 on hit, and others; always available in Heat
stances.note: A power-up, not a stance you hold: STB versions of moves (4,STB.2, d+1,STB.2, ws1,STB.2) become plus or splat. Wavu: in Heat he can always use Starburst moves.

keyMoves.summary: Burning Core: i13 knee, -4 on block, homing to sidesteps.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Use it a lot: fast, safe and tracking.

keyMoves.summary: Vanishing Storm: i18 homing mid, -8 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: Keep-out, homing and wall splat in one (Wavu).
keyMoves.use: At mid range against people who step or walk in.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The backbone of his space control.

keyMoves.summary: Sacred Edge: i18 homing high, +1 on block.
keyMoves.use: To keep the turn and catch sidesteps.

keyMoves.purpose: Another fast mid (Wavu lists it as a standing mid check).

keyMoves.summary: Sky Slash Nova: i15 launcher, -13 on block.

keyMoves.use: After -15 moves; the second hit only comes out as a punish or combo.

keyMoves.summary: Sylvia: i15 while-standing launcher, gives STB on hit.
keyMoves.use: After lows that are -15 or worse.

keyMoves.summary: Holy Smash: i11 while-standing mid, -6 on block.
Chaos Fist: i14 mid, launches on counter hit (+57a) and gives STB.
Blue Moon: i17 high-crushing move, launches on counter hit (+62a).
keyMoves.purpose: Crushes highs and launches on CH.

keyMoves.summary: Ira: i13 high, +6 on block, Heat Engager.
keyMoves.purpose: A plus-on-block Heat Engager from a run.
keyMoves.use: To close distance and start Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Roche Limit: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Wavu notes his throws are weak: use them as a mix-up only.
